simple.meaning: פֶּחָר (pechâr) is a Hebrew word meaning “a potter.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

definitions.full: H6353. pechar מֶּחָר noun masculine potter ( = pa——âr , מַּחָר ᵑ7 (also clay ), Syriac ; probably loan-word from Assyrian pa—aru , potter , compare Brock Zim Buhl ); — absolute ׳פ Dan 2:41 .
definitions.rootNote: (Aramaic) from an unused root probably meaning to fashion;

occurrences.englishText: Whereas you saw the feet and toes, part of potters’ clay, and part of iron, it will be a divided kingdom; but there will be in it of the strength of the iron, because you saw the iron mixed with miry clay.
